about: Made on a real iPhone (S0, 2026-11-11, an Xcode build: App Attest development). Nothing here is secret. s0-sigs.json: Secure Enclave ES256 signatures (Face ID key, passcode key) over spike payloads; the spike body predates k2.release v1's shape, so the strict reader refuses the payloads with code shape while the signatures verify. s0-attest.json: an App Attest attestation whose clientData is the spike form SPKI(biometric) || SPKI(passcode) (no K2-APPROVER-ENROL-1 prefix or challenge); verify it with the attestation check alone, not the enrolment check.

attest.enrolment_check: refused: the spike clientData has no K2-APPROVER-ENROL-1 prefix
